nom: Differin Face Scrub Daily Brightening Exfoliator

avis.texte: My doctor suggested I switch to the Differin skincare line due to hormonal acne and melasma. Unfortunately I did not realize the exfoliating agent for this face wash are tiny blue pieces of micro plastic. The face wash is gentle but cleansing and does not have an offensive scent but such a bummer that tiny pieces of plastics are exfoliating / penetrating your skin and then washing down your drain. This cleanser didn’t cause me to severely break out from the change but definitely will NOT purchase again unless manufacturer changes the exfoliant agent. Such a bummer because I do like the cleanser but can’t get past the fact these pieces of plastic are literally leaving my shower to leech into the ground water. 👎🏼

avis.titre: Great Value for a Gentle, Effective Exfoliator
avis.texte: I’ve been using the Differin Face Scrub Daily Brightening Exfoliator for a few weeks now, and I’m really impressed with the results, especially for the price point. It’s a gentle exfoliator that leaves my skin feeling smooth and refreshed without being too harsh or abrasive. What sets this apart from other scrubs I’ve tried is how it brightens my skin while keeping it hydrated. A lot of exfoliators tend to dry out my skin, but Differin strikes the perfect balance between exfoliating and moisturizing. I’ve noticed my complexion looks more even, and my skin feels softer after each use. The best part? The value. For a product that’s this effective and lasts as long as it does, the price is absolutely worth it. A little goes a long way, so one tube lasts quite a while. I also love that it’s non-irritating and works well with my sensitive skin. If you're looking for a daily exfoliator that brightens and smooths without breaking the bank, I highly recommend giving this one a try. It’s a great addition to any skincare routine!

avis.titre: Gentle Yet Effective Exfoliation for Clearer Skin!
avis.texte: I have acne-prone skin, so finding an exfoliator that’s both effective and gentle has been a challenge, until I tried the Differin Daily Brightening Exfoliator. The formula is mild enough for daily use but still does an amazing job at smoothing my skin and improving its overall tone and texture. The scrub has a creamy consistency with fine exfoliating beads that don’t feel harsh or irritating. After using it for a couple of weeks, I’ve noticed my skin looking brighter and more even, with fewer breakouts. It doesn’t dry out my skin either, which is a huge plus. If you’re looking for a daily exfoliator that won’t aggravate acne, this is a great option!

I tried this product out of curiosity since I was looking for a new cleanser. For context, I have sensitive, oily skin and also acne rosacea, so I did not have too much hope that this would work. Despite my worries, this product worked insanely well. I love the cooling effect it has but make sure to wet your face before. This product is definitely one of my favorites from differin and I totally recommend buying if you have the same skin type as me!!

avis.titre: Great to use in between products!
avis.texte: I alternate this and another differin daily face wash without exfoliation in it. I use this once/twice a week when I can feel a lot of black heads on my forehead and use the other the rest of the time. Using this routine helps keep my skin very clear and blackhead free. I wouldn't recommend using it everyday as exfoliating everyday does more harm than good. Love this product and the way it makes my skin feel.
My wife and I have been using this product for years and we both get compliments on our skin

avis.titre: Love how clean my skin feels!
avis.texte: I have been using this product for several months but just recently purchased through Amazon. The Brightening Exfoliator leaves my skin feeling clean and refreshed with no irritation. I recommend using only once per day or every other day (I use it nightly) as it may dry out skin. Definitely use a good moisturizer after. My skin tone and texture is brighter and more even when I use it regularly.
Scent free for my sensitive girlies. Abrasive enough to not irritate
It works great as an exfoliant but haven’t seen changes in dark spots, grant it I’m using order products so they might be counteracting each other

I love this product, i use it constantly so i know how the color a tecture is suppose to be. I had recieved 1 bottle and it was oxidized, old, and really hard to touch through the bottle. I got a replacement and its the same exact thing. So 2 bottles in total are damaged The seal was on both, but air has to have touched it inorder for it to oxidize. I have photos from google of what is is suppose to look like and photos of what i have gotten freshly opened.

avis.titre: Color change and bad smell from Amazon.
avis.texte: Purchased 5 times. The first 2 times, it was as expected. The scrub was white with green specs. The last 3 bottles I received were brownish with brown fluid com I ng out first with s bad smell. I called the company and was told that was not what should be in the bottle. They think it might be a storage issue. I'm going to try to order from another store off Amazon.
Product is undergoing a new packaging process. The product in old packaging is disgusting, brown, and smells weird.

Very disappointed. I don't have time to send this back. When I saw that the patches worked, I went for this because I knew it would work. I don't understand this not having an expiration date or the fact that the product might not have been stored correctly.

Like I said, in the video Differin does make some really good products, but this is NOT one of them. This is complete fail. I would not EVER RECOMMEND buyers purchase this product. It exfoliates nothing the consistency of the beads if any at all (LOL) is not there it’s very mentholated, so I guess it’s more of a mask than exfoliator. But yeah it’s not worth your hard earned money. If I could give it zero stars I would but I guess with this rating system they at least get one in every category.

avis.titre: If you want your face to feel like it’s on fire, use this!
avis.texte: I was really excited to try the Brightening Exfoliating Scrub because I like the Differin Gel so much. It was horrible. I honestly want my money back. It felt fine when it was on, but my face had red splotches afterwards. Thought maybe it was a first-time fluke. Second time, same thing happened. Then I put some face serum on, and it felt like my face was on fire. I tried so hard to wipe my face off with water and ice cubes, but it burned for a long while after. Also, a lot of differin products contain alcohols, parabens, and sulfates…come up with some less crappy ingredients to use.
The product is supposed to be bright blue/ mint color with no smell. This batch is old and had an odor.

This gel is different than what is sold in other stores! Even the tub it came in was different with the word "cleanse" on the tube. It doesn't work...burns the skin and leaves it dry. Wish I could get my money refunded. Same on you for this!!!!!
